note: Hill County (MT) administers county zoning for unincorporated land, and Havre (largest city) publishes its zoning only as a static PDF map (ci.havre.mt.us/s/ZONING-MAP.pdf). Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the Montana state GIS services (gisservice.mt.gov MSDI directory) found no queryable zoning district layer for Hill County or Havre. County zoning appears only as PDF/viewer material.
